listenings.text: Hi, I'm Bram, and I'm a sound engineer from Rotterdam. I have worked on four world tours. I have been to more than forty countries, but I have seen almost nothing of them: only airports, hotels and stadiums. My job is to make the music sound good for the crowd, from the first row to the last. The most difficult place? Old stadiums, with a lot of echo. The best moment of my career? I have heard seventy thousand people sing along to one song, with no music, only voices. I have never forgotten it. People ask me: have you ever met the band? Yes, I have. They are very normal people.

Hello, I'm Lucy, and music is my big passion. I have seen Coldplay live five times, in three different countries. The first time was in London, in 2012, and I cried during the last song. I have traveled to Paris and to Madrid only for their concerts. My friends think I'm crazy. I have also seen U2 once, in a stadium in Dublin. It was raining, but nobody cared. But I have never seen Dua Lipa. My daughter loves her, so I'm going to take her to a concert next year. It's going to be her first concert, and my first time as a mother in the crowd.

paras: Have you ever been to a stadium concert? For many fans, it is the best night of the year. On Coldplay’s world tour, every person in the crowd gets a wristband with a small light. During the songs, seventy thousand lights change color at the same time, and the stadium looks like a sky full of stars. Coldplay have played in Brazil many times, and many fans have seen them more than once.

U2 have played live for more than forty years. The Irish band has filled stadiums all over the world, and in 2023 they started a series of concerts in a very different place: the Sphere, in Las Vegas, a round building with a giant screen inside. Fans who have seen it say they have never seen anything like it.

Dua Lipa is younger, but she has already done big world tours. Her shows are pure dance: lights, dancers and songs that everybody knows. The crowd sings along from the first song to the last, and many fans know all the lyrics. Some people go for the opening act, too: it is often a new artist who becomes famous a year later.
